items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I've heard you sing about Matty Campbell. Did you know Matty Campbell? It's just something in the song, huh? Yeah. Works like Matty Campbell.

ctx.x: I don't know. How many brothers and sisters did I have? You got a bunch of them? Yep. You were nine boys a few. Nine boys a few. Nine boys a few. Nine boys a few.

I've heard you sing about Matty Campbell. Did you know Matty Campbell? It's just something in the song, huh? Yeah. Works like Matty Campbell. Did you ever play at any jazz festivals other than in New Orleans? Only in New Orleans. Only in New Orleans.
Only in New Orleans. Yeah. But you did make a tour. You went out to California, New York. Right. That was colleges. Right. But this is the only jazz festival. Right.
